checked_before_probe: 规划/项目数据总清单与下载安排.md
dedup_check.finding: No prior CNINFO historical disclosure full-text corpus or query manifest exists. Existing limited forecasts, issuer notices/corporate-action records, market data and email files were not duplicated. This probe adds only a bounded public metadata sample.

official_site.identity: Official page identifies CNINFO as a securities-information site operated by Shenzhen Securities Information Co., a wholly owned subsidiary of Shenzhen Stock Exchange; page exposes announcement search.

frontend_evidence.source_code_evidence: getHistory() posts pageNum,pageSize,column,tabName,plate,stock,searchkey,secid,category,trade,seDate,sortName,sortType,isHLtitle; result metadata maps announcementTime and announcementTitle; link builder combines announcementId, secCode, orgId, announcementTime for detail and uses adjunctUrl for attachment path.
frontend_evidence.base_path_evidence: Search page HTML sets path=/new and v3_cninfo=https://static.cninfo.com.cn when served over HTTPS.

metadata_probe.column_parameter: sse as submitted; mixed pageColumn values returned, so exchange-isolation semantics are not established
metadata_probe.body_field_in_response: announcementContent is empty in the sampled metadata row.
metadata_probe.announcement_time_encoding: Unix epoch integer in milliseconds; sampled value resolves to 2025-12-31 22:10:01 Asia/Shanghai, so hour/minute/second are represented in this sample (not just a calendar date).
metadata_probe.correction_or_revision_note: The sampled API record exposes associateAnnouncement, storageTime and a unique announcementId, but all first-ten associateAnnouncement values are empty and storageTime is null. This does not establish a correction/version chain; it also does not negate the stable path returned for an original notice. A separate corrected-notice linkage test remains open.
metadata_probe.record_count_claim: 4498 is the endpoint-reported result count for this exact searchkey/date query, not a count of all A-share disclosures or a completeness audit.

attachment_assessment.result: Stable official attachment path candidate observed across identical repeated query response; includes publication-date directory and announcementId. Actual PDF bytes, content SHA, permanence/immutability across later revisions, and historical archived vintage were not checked.

what_gap_it_can_address: Public query returns security code, title, millisecond announcement time, announcement ID, and relative PDF attachment path. This supports discovering and time-stamping official company disclosure candidates such as earnings forecasts.
what_remains_open: This is an issuer-disclosure metadata endpoint, not a full news body API; event text is not returned in the sample.
No PDF was opened/downloaded, so body extraction and whether operating/orders/earnings events are usable remain unverified.
Historical first-public version, revised notices, backfilled/corrected items, archive vintage and re-use/license terms remain unverified.
Two identical queries demonstrate repeat stability for the captured page only; not permanent attachment immutability.
One keyword and one year were sampled; no completeness/recall or full market coverage claim.
bounded_next_step: If separately authorized, retrieve at most 10–20 already filtered 2025 candidate PDF metadata URLs in a second audit, with exact SHA, publisher time and company code; download only a tiny selected PDF sample if permitted, then test text extraction/version handling before any broader collection. No registration/payment/bypass.
reproduction_command: curl.exe --fail --silent --show-error --max-filesize 1048576 -X POST "https://www.cninfo.com.cn/new/hisAnnouncement/query" -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8" -H "Referer: https://www.cninfo.com.cn/new/commonUrl/pageOfSearch?url=disclosure/list/search" -H "Origin: https://www.cninfo.com.cn" -H "X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest" --data-urlencode "pageNum=1" --data-urlencode "pageSize=10" --data-urlencode "column=sse" --data-urlencode "tabName=fulltext" --data-urlencode "plate=" --data-urlencode "stock=" --data-urlencode "searchkey=业绩预告" --data-urlencode "secid=" --data-urlencode "category=" --data-urlencode "trade=" --data-urlencode "seDate=2025-01-01~2025-12-31" --data-urlencode "sortName=time" --data-urlencode "sortType=desc" --data-urlencode "isHLtitle=true" -o results/cninfo_historical_text_probe_v1/repeat_2025_metadata.json
transfer_bytes_note: 291,810 bytes is the aggregate byte count of the locally fetched official HTML/JS and two bounded JSON metadata responses; saved files are below the 2 MiB cap.
